high_level_description: stc brand style, a triptych aerial view of vehicles driving over stone pavement, desert dunes, and a coastal bridge, overlaid with UI tracking icons.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Three vertical aerial panels side by side: grey stone pavement, orange desert dunes, and a teal coastal bridge over water.

elements.desc: A white car driving over a grey stone-paved road, with a signal-strength icon nearby.
A white pickup truck driving through a road cutting through orange desert dunes, with a warning triangle icon nearby.
A truck with a purple cab driving over a bridge across teal water, with a menu icon nearby.
White route progress bar and distance readout displayed over the desert panel.
